authority: Documentary synthesis only; does not amend formal verdicts, active registration, gates, accepted source, or production policy.

coverage.count_interpretation: Different questions, reused states and cohorts; these counts are not a model success rate or independent sample size.
coverage.background_not_fully_catalogued: Selected C225-C259 reports, Gate A-D decisions, current handoff, architecture/roadmap and the unadopted standalone-language proposal; see human report sources.
coverage.null_means: Not measured, not reported in the selected source, or not applicable as specified by the adjacent record; never zero by imputation.

interpretation_rules: Within-experiment paired effects are primary; cross-C raw accuracy is not a causal time trend.
Diagnostic-integrity PASS is distinct from bounded-capability PASS and from Gate F completion.
TRAIN/HOLDOUT value-combination labels do not imply the evaluated name length or prompt was fitted; original6 has zero fitting exposure in C329-C344.
Answers, both-query pairs, both-order groups, local gate cells and all-condition seed gates are different units.
Record rescues and regressions, not net gains alone; keep all preregistered seeds.
Rows reused across languages, profiles, permutations and checkpoints are dependent; no new significance test is claimed.
Parameter count, trainable count, updates, presented rows, nonpadding tokens, FLOPs and wall-clock are distinct budget measures.
Fixed-checkpoint interventions, fresh training comparisons and fresh-seed replications cannot be interchanged.
Compatibility family is a search aid, never permission to pool gates or declare matched budgets.
Invalid attempts are separate execution history and are not negative capability samples.
C345 preregistration is provided separately below with actual_results=null; no C345 result is inferred.
This is a source-linked documentation index, not an export of native runs, checkpoints, datasets or formal experimental output artifacts.
